key.name: animation-time
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the popup open/close animation.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size in pixels of the icon image inside each tile.

key.name: cell-width
key.description: Fixed width of each grid cell (icon + label). Must be larger than icon-size.

key.name: cell-height
key.description: Minimum height of each grid cell (icon + label).

key.name: col-spacing
key.description: Horizontal gap in pixels between icon columns.

key.name: row-spacing
key.description: Vertical gap in pixels between icon rows.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: Fallback size of the extension icon in the dock. The dock may override this value at runtime.

key.name: popup-height
key.description: Maximum popup height in pixels. The actual height may be smaller if the bottom-fraction gap is reached first.

key.name: grid-margin-px
key.description: Pixel inset subtracted from the popup width and height when calculating the icon grid area, preventing overflow at the borders and scrollbar.

key.name: top-fraction
key.description: Minimum distance from the top of the monitor. The popup is bottom-anchored; this prevents it from extending too far upward. e.g. 0.12 = 12%.

key.name: bottom-fraction
key.description: Primary position anchor: the popup bottom edge is placed this far from the monitor bottom (above the dock). e.g. 0.12 = 12%.

key.name: min-cols
key.description: Minimum number of icon columns in the grid, regardless of monitor size.

key.name: max-cols
key.description: Caps the maximum number of columns. When 0, the count is calculated automatically based on monitor size.

key.name: hide-show-apps-button
key.description: When true, the dock's built-in "Show Applications" button is hidden so the Compact Launcher button is the only app launcher icon.

key.name: dock-position
key.description: Position of the extension button in the dock: 'left' (first) or 'right' (last).

key.name: hidden-apps
key.description: List of exact names or wildcard patterns (*) to hide from the grid. e.g. "Logs", "Libre*".

key.name: toggle-launcher
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to open the launcher
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut that toggles the Compact Launcher popup. Empty = disabled.
